text:
maria: quick heads-up — sandbox: org-level API key showing up in a project GPU pool even when no X-Project header sent.

josh: ouch. paste the curl?

maria: sure:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer org_pk_PRJTEST" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gptx-8k","prompt":"test"}'
```
(no X-Project header, still appears under project:prod-alg in console)

kevin: sounds like the old "sticky" affinity behavior — org keys bind to last-used project for a short TTL to avoid cold starts.

sophia: do we have a trace from auth-router? need to know which decision rule fired and why.

maria: got it, auth-router log: `route=project_pool pool=prod-alg reason=sticky_affinity ttl=300s`

billing-bot: seeing invoice noise — some of these calls billed to org quota, others to project. support tickets rising.

kevin: current flow decouples routing and metering: router picks pool, meter picks owner via claim precedence; if they diverge during the request attribution flips.

sophia: proposed deterministic precedence: 1) X-Project header wins, 2) impersonation claims, 3) sticky affinity fallback. Also emit telemetry event when route_owner != meter_owner.

ops-oncall: please enable sampled full traces (headers + route decision + meter decision) in sandbox — 1:100 for 24h.

maria: enabled sampling flag `authz.trace=affinity-mismatch` and added query: `select * from request_trace where route_owner != meter_owner limit 500`.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled: `auth-router.sticky_affinity_ttl=0` on sandbox at 1767900000 behind feature-flag `ff.authz.sticky_affinity_disable`

josh: good. gate it so Dedicated customers aren't affected by accident.

kevin: rollout plan: (A) sandbox canary TTL=0 + sampling, (B) add telemetry event + alert on mismatch rate > 0.1%, (C) unit/integration tests for attribution precedence, (D) API opt-out header `X-Routing-Prefer: pool` for explicit customer intent.

sophia: UX ask: console request detail should surface the effective auth tuple, e.g. "auth: org_key (sticky->project:prod-alg)" with a link to trace.

maria: filed OBS-8133 "authz: affinity vs metering attribution clarity" assigned to maria, kevin. attaching sampled traces.

ops-oncall: if no regressions in 90m after canary, promote to staging. ping here when ready to roll.

maria: monitoring now. I will post updates. thanks :thumbsup:
